verdict.rationale: Box's docs explicitly describe a Chunked Upload API for reliably uploading large files by splitting into parts that are uploaded individually and then committed, which is the standard resumable/chunked pattern (box-docs-2, box-docs-40). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resuming a session after a dropped connection (retry semantics, session expiry) and independent/hands-on corroboration of resumability in practice.
